title: Easy To See Ores
description: Makes all ores 2 coloured and make them easier to see.
body:
Easy to See Ores – Full Ore Texture Pack

Description:
Make mining effortless with Easy to See Ores! This full texture pack completely recolors all ores — Overworld and Nether — for maximum visibility and a fresh, vibrant look.

Every ore is carefully designed:

Overworld Ores: Clear, high-contrast colors for fast identification (e.g., diamonds are pure blue, copper is bright blue + orange).

Nether Ores: Multi-color designs for standout visibility in the Nether (e.g., Nether Gold Ore and Nether Quartz Ore use 3-color patterns for depth).

Consistent Style: All ores follow a readable, visually appealing style without altering gameplay.

Features:

Complete recolor of every ore block, including deepslate and Nether variants

High contrast and easy spotting in any biome

Stylish and efficient design

Lightweight and fully compatible with vanilla Minecraft

Upgrade your mining experience and never miss an ore again!

Why This Texture Pack?

Easy to See Ores was created to make mining in Minecraft faster, easier, and more enjoyable. If you’ve ever struggled to spot ores in caves, tunnels, or the busy red backgrounds of the Nether, this pack is for you.

Boost Efficiency: High-contrast and vibrant colors make ores instantly noticeable, so you spend less time searching and more time mining.

Full Coverage: All ores are recolored, including Overworld, Deepslate, and Nether variants, giving a consistent and clean look across your world.

Custom Design Choices: Each ore’s color scheme is carefully chosen for readability and style (like diamonds being pure blue and copper bright blue + orange).

Vanilla-Compatible: It doesn’t change gameplay — only the visuals — so it works on your favorite servers or single-player worlds.

Unique Mining Experience: Makes exploring caves, the Nether, and mining expeditions visually satisfying while keeping it practical.

In short: If you want ores that are impossible to miss and a visually refreshing mining experience, Easy to See Ores is the pack for you.
